description: Evaluation cases for the service desk agent. expected_document is the knowledge article that should be retrieved; null means the knowledge base genuinely has no answer and the right behaviour is to admit that rather than guess. expected_escalation is what the confidence/risk gate should decide.

cases.subject: Account keeps locking every few minutes
cases.description: My account locks itself about every ten minutes. I unlock it and it happens again.

cases.subject: Locked out again after unlocking
cases.description: IT unlocked my account this morning and by lunchtime it was locked again. Nothing I do seems to stop it.

cases.subject: Repeated lockouts on my work login
cases.description: Something keeps locking my login. I have changed my password twice and it still happens.

cases.subject: Why does my account lock on its own
cases.description: Nobody else uses my machine but my account is locked several times a day.

cases.subject: Email not syncing on my phone
cases.description: My work email stopped updating on my mobile since yesterday. It works fine on the laptop.

cases.subject: Mobile mail app stuck on old messages
cases.description: The mail app on my phone shows messages from two days ago and will not refresh.

cases.subject: Phone stopped receiving work email
cases.description: I am not getting any new work email on my handset. Desktop is fine.

cases.subject: Outlook on mobile will not download new mail
cases.description: New mail does not appear on my phone unless I open it on my computer first.

cases.subject: Laptop very slow after the update
cases.description: Since the update installed on Friday my laptop takes ten minutes to become usable.

cases.subject: Machine crawling since latest patch
cases.description: Everything is sluggish after the patch last week. Fans are loud and apps hang.

cases.subject: Computer unusable in the mornings
cases.description: For the first fifteen minutes after logging in the laptop is unusably slow. Started after an update.

cases.subject: High disk usage since Windows update
cases.description: Task manager shows disk at 100 percent constantly since the update went on.

cases.subject: New starter cannot access anything
cases.description: Our new developer started today and cannot sign in to email or the code repository.

cases.subject: New joiner has no accounts set up
cases.description: The new analyst has been here two days and still has no system access at all.

cases.subject: Missing permissions for new team member
cases.description: My new report can log in but cannot see any of the team's shared systems.

cases.subject: Starter account created but not usable
cases.description: HR says the account was created last week but the new starter cannot actually sign in anywhere.

cases.subject: How do I reset my password
cases.description: I have forgotten my password and want to reset it myself without raising a ticket.

cases.subject: Cannot log in after resetting password
cases.description: I reset my password but I still cannot log in, and I have a customer demo shortly.

cases.subject: Self service reset not working for me
cases.description: The forgotten password page says it cannot verify me. I do not think I have a phone registered.

cases.subject: New password rejected as too short
cases.description: The reset page keeps refusing my new password and I do not know the rules.

cases.subject: Payroll portal says access denied
cases.description: I cannot open the payroll portal, it shows access denied. I need to submit expenses.

cases.subject: Locked out of expenses system
cases.description: The expenses and payroll site refuses to let me in since the weekend.

cases.subject: Cannot see my payslips
cases.description: The payroll portal loads but says I do not have permission to view payslips.

cases.subject: Access denied on finance system
cases.description: Every time I sign in to the payroll system it immediately says access denied.

cases.subject: Print jobs stuck in the queue
cases.description: Nothing prints. The queue shows five documents that never clear.

cases.subject: Printer says ready but nothing comes out
cases.description: The printer looks online but my documents sit in the queue forever.

cases.subject: Cannot cancel a stuck print job
cases.description: There is a document jammed in the print queue and cancelling does nothing.

cases.subject: Whole office queue has stopped
cases.description: No one on our floor can print, everything is backing up in the queue.

cases.subject: VPN will not connect after password change
cases.description: Since I changed my password the VPN client fails to authenticate.

cases.subject: VPN keeps dropping every few minutes
cases.description: The VPN disconnects constantly and asks me to sign in again each time.

cases.subject: Cannot work from home, VPN fails
cases.description: The VPN refuses my credentials from home but the same login works in the office.

cases.subject: Remote access authentication error
cases.description: Remote access client shows an authentication error every time I try to connect.

cases.subject: Coffee machine on floor 3 is broken
cases.description: The espresso machine in the third floor kitchen is grinding loudly and leaking water.

cases.subject: What is the capital of France
cases.description: Just curious, can you tell me the capital city of France?

cases.subject: Booking annual leave for December
cases.description: How many days of annual leave do I have left and how do I book time off over Christmas?

cases.subject: Car park barrier will not lift
cases.description: My pass does not open the car park barrier in the morning.

cases.subject: Fire alarm test schedule
cases.description: When is the next scheduled fire alarm test for the building?

cases.subject: Desk chair is broken
cases.description: The height adjustment on my chair has failed and it sinks to the bottom.

cases.subject: Recommend a restaurant for a team lunch
cases.description: We want somewhere nearby for a team lunch next week, any suggestions?

cases.subject: Air conditioning too cold in meeting room 2
cases.description: Meeting room 2 is freezing, can the air conditioning be turned down?

cases.subject: I lost my phone and cannot get my sign-in codes
cases.description: My phone was stolen at the weekend. The authenticator app was on it and I cannot sign in to anything now.

cases.subject: New handset, authenticator gone
cases.description: I upgraded my phone and did not move the authenticator across. The old one has been wiped. How do I get set up again?

cases.subject: MFA prompt but no way to approve it
cases.description: Sign-in asks me to approve on my device but that device no longer exists. I still have my old SMS number registered if that helps.

cases.subject: Need my two factor reset, no methods left
cases.description: Phone gone, no SMS number on the account, no backup codes saved. I think this needs someone to verify who I am before it can be reset.

cases.subject: Suspicious email asking me to confirm my details
cases.description: Got an email that looks like it is from finance asking me to confirm bank details on a link. I have not clicked it. What should I do with it?

cases.subject: Should I forward a dodgy email to you?
cases.description: There is a scam email in my inbox. Do you want me to forward it over so you can look at it?

cases.subject: Reported a phishing message and heard nothing
cases.description: I used the report button on a suspicious email a few days ago and nobody has come back to me. Did it actually go anywhere?

cases.subject: I clicked a link in a phishing email and entered my password
cases.description: I realised too late. I put my username and password into a page that came from a fake email about an hour ago. This feels like a security incident.

cases.subject: No space left on my laptop
cases.description: I keep getting a warning that my disk is nearly full and updates have stopped installing.

cases.subject: Cannot save anything, drive says it is full
cases.description: Applications will not open and I cannot save files. Windows says there is almost no space left on the C drive.

cases.subject: What is safe to delete to free up space?
cases.description: I am down to about a gigabyte free. I do not want to delete the wrong thing, what is usually taking it all up?

cases.subject: Updates failing and I think it is storage
cases.description: My machine has not taken an update in weeks and it fails without saying why. Someone said it might be because the disk is full.

cases.subject: Wi-Fi password for a visitor tomorrow
cases.description: I have a client in tomorrow morning and they will need internet. What is the guest wifi password?

cases.subject: How do visitors get online?
cases.description: Someone is coming in for a meeting and asked how they connect to the wifi. Do I need to raise anything in advance?

cases.subject: Contractor here for three weeks needs network access
cases.description: We have a contractor on site until the end of the month and guest access keeps expiring on them. Is there something longer term?

cases.subject: Visitor on guest wifi cannot reach the shared drive
cases.description: Our visitor connected to the guest network fine but cannot open anything on the shared drive or print. Is that expected?

cases.subject: Second screen not being picked up
cases.description: My external monitor is plugged in but the laptop does not see it at all. Nothing on screen.

cases.subject: Monitor keeps flickering on and off
cases.description: The external display flickers every few seconds and sometimes drops out completely, then comes back.

cases.subject: Screens worked yesterday, nothing today through the dock
cases.description: Both monitors were fine on Friday. Today neither works through the dock, though the laptop screen is fine.

cases.subject: Display arrangement is wrong after changing desks
cases.description: I moved to a different desk and now the second screen is mirrored instead of extended and I cannot get it back.

cases.subject: Laptop is not charging
cases.description: Plugged in all morning and the battery is still going down. The charger light does not seem to come on.

cases.subject: Only charges through one port
cases.description: The charger only does anything in one of the USB-C ports. Is the other one broken?

cases.subject: Dies instantly when I unplug it
cases.description: The machine runs perfectly while plugged in but shuts off the second I take the cable out, even though it says it is charged.

cases.subject: Charging stopped working since I started using the dock
cases.description: Charging was fine off the wall charger. Since I started using the dock the battery slowly drains during the day.

cases.subject: Browser warning me the connection is not private
cases.description: Getting a big red warning when I open one of our internal sites. It says the certificate is not trusted.

cases.subject: Certificate expired message on an internal tool
cases.description: The intranet is showing a certificate expired warning this morning. A few of us are seeing it.

cases.subject: Only my machine shows the certificate error
cases.description: Everyone else can open the site fine but mine says the certificate is invalid. My laptop was rebuilt last week.

cases.subject: Is it safe to click through this warning?
cases.description: I get a warning about the site being insecure when I am on the hotel wifi. Should I just continue past it?

cases.subject: Deleted a file by mistake
cases.description: I deleted a document from my synced folder yesterday and need it back. Can you restore it?

cases.subject: Saved over a document and lost the original
cases.description: I opened last month's version and saved over it with this month's figures. The recycle bin is empty because it was not deleted.

cases.subject: How far back can files be recovered?
cases.description: Someone on my team deleted something in the summer and is asking whether it is still recoverable. How long do you keep them?

cases.subject: Need an old version of a spreadsheet back
cases.description: The spreadsheet is still there but the numbers are wrong because someone edited it. I want the version from before that.

cases.subject: Cannot share my screen in meetings
cases.description: When I click share screen the other people just see a black rectangle. No error message.

cases.subject: Screen share frozen on the first frame
cases.description: People say my shared screen is stuck on whatever was showing when I started sharing and never updates.

cases.subject: New laptop cannot present
cases.description: Got a replacement laptop on Monday and sharing has not worked since. It worked fine on the old one.

cases.subject: Changed the permission but sharing still fails
cases.description: I turned on the screen recording permission like a colleague suggested and it made no difference at all.

cases.subject: Need access to a team folder
cases.description: I cannot open one of the shared folders I need for a piece of work. Can you add me?

cases.subject: Access denied on a shared drive
cases.description: Getting access denied when I open a shared location that I am supposed to have. Who grants that?

cases.subject: Access was approved but still not working
cases.description: I was told my request to the folder was approved this morning but I still cannot get in.

cases.subject: Who owns a shared folder?
cases.description: I need to request access to a folder but I have no idea which team looks after it. How do I find out?

cases.subject: Need an application installing
cases.description: Can someone install an application on my laptop? I do not have an admin password.

cases.subject: Requesting a tool that is not in the portal
cases.description: The design tool I need is not listed in the company portal. How do I get it approved?

cases.subject: How long does a software request take?
cases.description: I asked for a piece of software last week and have not heard anything. What is the usual turnaround?

cases.subject: Portal install asks for an admin password
cases.description: I tried installing something from the portal and it prompted me for admin credentials which I do not have.

cases.subject: Application times out when I try to save
cases.description: Every time I save, it spins for a while and then says the request timed out. Nothing gets saved.

cases.subject: App hangs after being left open overnight
cases.description: I left the application open overnight and this morning it will not save anything, though it still shows me as signed in.

cases.subject: Saving fails from home but works in the office
cases.description: Saving works fine on the office network. From home it times out every time. VPN is connected.

cases.subject: Losing work because saves keep failing
cases.description: I have lost an hour of work twice this week because the save times out and then the page will not let me try again.
